exposure: Group 1: Gynecological oncologist present at the start of the procedure
Group 2: Gynecological oncologist called in during the procedure
Presence of a gynecological oncologist at the start of the procedure
cohort: 98 cases of histologically confirmed abnormally invasive placenta
finding: Early presence of a gynecological oncologist at delivery for suspected abnormally invasive placenta was associated with lower blood loss and transfusion requirements.
